```{r}
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(jpeg)

get_comp_bw <- function(name) {
  # Criei uma função para o output do multithreading ser uma lista facil de trabalhar
  my_list = function(x,y){
    new_list = list()
    if(x |> is.list()){
      for(n in 1:length(x)){
        new_list[[n]] = x[[n]]
      }
      new_list[[n+1]] = y
      return(new_list)
    }
    if(y |> is.list()){
      for(n in 1:length(y)){
        new_list[[n]] = y[[n]]
      }
      new_list[[n+1]] = x
      return(new_list)
    }
    return(list(x,y))
  }
  
  # Lendo a imagem
  path <- paste0(name, ".jpg")
  img <- readJPEG(path)
  
  # Convertendo a imagem para preto e branco
  if (length(dim(img)) > 2) {
    img <- 0.2989 * img[, , 1] + 0.5870 * img[, , 2] + 0.1140 * img[, , 3]
  }
  
  # Calculando a fatoração SVD
  print("Calculating SVD...")
  svd_res <- svd(img)
  print("SVD Ready")
  
  vetor <- c(95, 90, 80, 70, 50, 25, 10, 9:1)
  lista_imgs <- vector("list", length(vetor))
  
  # Multithreading
  num_cores <- detectCores()
  cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  clusterExport(cl, c("img", "svd_res"), envir = environment())
  
  # Aplicando a compressão para a imagem em vários níveis: 95, 90, 80, 70, etc...
  lista = foreach(n = vetor, .combine = 'my_list') %dopar% {
    scale <- n / 100
    k <- round(scale * length(svd_res$d))
    
    # Trucando a matrizes diagonal do SVD
    svd_res$d[(k+1):length(svd_res$d)] <- 0
    
    # Reconstruindo a imagem comprimida usando o SVD truncado 
    compressed_img <- svd_res$u %*% diag(svd_res$d) %*% t(svd_res$v)
  
    compressed_img
  }
  
  # Parando o multithreading
  stopCluster(cl)
  registerDoSEQ()
  
  # Salvando as imagens
  for(n in 1:length(lista)){
    nome <- paste0("Imagens/", name,"/Comp", name, vetor[n], ".jpg")
    writeJPEG(lista[[n]], nome)
  }
  
  return("Salvo")
}
```

```{r}
get_comp_col <- function(name) {
  # Criei uma função para o output do multithreading ser uma lista facil de trabalhar
  my_list = function(x, y) {
    new_list = list()
    if (x |> is.list()) {
      for (n in 1:length(x)) {
        new_list[[n]] = x[[n]]
      }
      new_list[[n + 1]] = y
      return(new_list)
    }
    if (y |> is.list()) {
      for (n in 1:length(y)) {
        new_list[[n]] = y[[n]]
      }
      new_list[[n + 1]] = x
      return(new_list)
    }
    return(list(x, y))
  }
  
  # Lendo a imagem
  path <- paste0(name, ".jpg")
  img <- readJPEG(path)
  
  
  # Calculando a fatoração SVD
  print("Calculating SVD...")
  
  svd_res <- list()
  for (channel in 1:3) {
    channel_img <- img[, , channel]
    svd_res[[channel]] <- svd(channel_img)
  }
  
  print("SVD Ready")
  
  vetor <- c(95, 90, 80, 70, 50, 25, 10, 9:1)
  lista_imgs <- vector("list", length(vetor))
  
  # Multithreading
  num_cores <- detectCores()
  cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  clusterExport(cl, c("img", "svd_res"), envir = environment())
  
  # Aplicando a compressão para a imagem em vários níveis: 95, 90, 80, 70, etc...
  lista <- foreach(n = vetor, .combine = 'my_list') %dopar% {
    scale <- n / 100
    k <- round(scale * min(sapply(svd_res, function(x) length(x$d))))
    
    # Truncate the singular value matrices for each channel
    for (channel in 1:3) {
      svd_res[[channel]]$d[(k + 1):length(svd_res[[channel]]$d)] <- 0
    }
    
    # Reconstruct the compressed image using the truncated SVD for each channel
    compressed_img <- array(0, dim = dim(img))
    for (channel in 1:3) {
      compressed_img[, , channel] <- svd_res[[channel]]$u %*% diag(svd_res[[channel]]$d) %*% t(svd_res[[channel]]$v)
    }
    
    compressed_img
  }
  
  # Parando o multithreading
  stopCluster(cl)
  registerDoSEQ()
  
  # Salvando as imagens
  for (n in 1:length(lista)) {
    nome <- paste0("Imagens/", name, "Colorido/Comp", name, vetor[n], ".jpg")
    writeJPEG(lista[[n]], nome)
  }
  
  return("Salvo")
}
```

```{r}
get_comp_bw("darksouls")
```

```{r}
bw_2 <- function(name) {
  my_list <- function(x, y) {
    new_list <- list()
    if (is.list(x)) {
      for (n in 1:length(x)) {
        new_list[[n]] <- x[[n]]
      }
      new_list[[n+1]] <- y
      return(new_list)
    }
    if (is.list(y)) {
      for (n in 1:length(y)) {
        new_list[[n]] <- y[[n]]
      }
      new_list[[n+1]] <- x
      return(new_list)
    }
    return(list(x, y))
  }
  
  path <- paste0(name, ".jpg")
  img <- readJPEG(path)
  
  if (length(dim(img)) > 2) {
    img <- 0.2989 * img[, , 1] + 0.5870 * img[, , 2] + 0.1140 * img[, , 3]
  }
  
  svd_res <- svd(img)
  
  vetor <- c(95, 90, 80, 70, 50, 25, 10, 9:1)
  lista_imgs <- vector("list", length(vetor))
  
  lista <- vector("list", length(vetor))
  for (n in 1:length(vetor)) {
    scale <- vetor[n] / 100
    k <- round(scale * length(svd_res$d))
    
    svd_res$d[(k + 1):length(svd_res$d)] <- 0
    
    compressed_img <- svd_res$u %*% diag(svd_res$d) %*% t(svd_res$v)
  
    lista[[n]] <- compressed_img
  }
  
  for (n in 1:length(lista)) {
    nome <- paste0("Imagens/", name, "/Comp", name, vetor[n], ".jpg")
    writeJPEG(lista[[n]], nome)
  }
  
  return(lista)
}

```

```{r}
library(microbenchmark)

microbenchmark(get_comp_bw("Voyager"), bw_2("Voyager"), times = 2)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
plot_image_sizes <- function(image_paths) {
  sizes <- c()
  labels <- c()

  # Iterar sobre cada caminho de imagem
  for (path in image_paths) {
    # Obter o tamanho do arquivo em bytes
    file_size <- file.info(path)$size

    # Adicionar o tamanho e o rótulo à lista
    sizes <- c(sizes, file_size)
    labels <- c(labels, basename(path))
  }
  
  dados = data.frame(sizes = sizes, labels = labels)
  ggplot(dados, aes(x = 1:length(labels), y = sizes))+
    geom_line(linewidth = 2)+
    theme_classic()+ 
    scale_x_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 95, by = 5))+
    labs(x = "Qualidade da Imagem", y = "Tamanho em KBs")

}

plot_image_sizes(paste0("Imagens/Hubble1/CompHubble", 1:95, ".jpg"))
```
